description_en: Creates multiple ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) database Classic Edition instances
description_zh: 批量创建云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）经典版实例
name: CreateInstances

parameters.help_en: The configuration information of the new instances. The value must be in JSON format. For more information, see the supplementary description of the Instances parameter
parameters.help_zh: 新实例的配置信息，格式为JSON，详细说明请参见Instances参数补充说明
parameters.name: instances

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. This is the default value.
false: disables automatic payment. You must manually pay for the order. In the top navigation bar of the console, choose Billing > Renewal Management. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Order Management > My Orders, find the order, and then complete the payment.

This parameter is available only when the ChargeType parameter in the Instances array is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值：

true：自动付费，默认值。
false：手动付费。您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理 > 我的订单，找到目标订单进行支付。

Instances参数中，ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The Redis-compatible engine version of the instance. Valid values: 4.0 and 5.0.
Default value: 5.0
parameters.help_zh:
实例兼容Redis的版本，取值：4.0、5.0。
默认值为5.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to rebuild and restore the source instance from the recycle bin. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no. This is the default value.

This parameter is available only when the SrcDBInstanceId parameter is specified in the Instances array
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要从回收站中重建恢复源实例，取值：
true：需要。
false：不需要，默认值。

Instances参数中设置了SrcDBInstanceId参数时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: rebuild_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal. This is the default value.

This parameter is available only when the ChargeType parameter in the Instances array is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启，默认值。

Instances参数中，ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
